sources.summary: An open corner facing the city and a design that seeks to transform the brand, facade, dining room, and kitchen into a unique experience. Located in the Itaim neighborhood of São Paulo, Marmotta was conceived to establish a direct, vibrant, and welcoming relationship between the street and the dining room. The project takes advantage of its corner location to transform the facade into a focal point, where architecture, visual identity, and dining experience meet.
